name: buck2-test
description: Run Buck2 tests from the VS Code Testing view.

buck2Test.executorPath.description: Path to the Rust Buck2 test executor. Empty uses the bundled helper or checkout build.

buck2Test.targetPatterns.description: Buck2 target patterns used when discovering tests.

buck2Test.listArgument.description: Argument appended to a test command for Buck2 listing execution.

buck2Test.locationArgument.description: Argument appended during listing to emit test source locations.

buck2Test.caseArgument.description: Argument template used to select one case; {} is replaced with the case name.

buck2Test.debuggerType.description: Debug adapter type used by the Debug test profile. "lldb" is CodeLLDB (vadimcn.vscode-lldb); "cppdbg" is the C/C++ extension's adapter (ms-vscode.cpptools), which can front either LLDB or GDB.

buck2Test.debugConfiguration.description: Extra keys merged into the generated debug configuration. Set anything the chosen adapter supports, for example {"MIMode": "gdb"} for cppdbg or {"sourceMap": {}} for lldb. Keys here override the generated ones.
